light_description: Gated silicon fuzz and distortion spanning warm low-gain grit through saturated, sputtery and shoegaze-style fuzz textures.
Fuzz and resonant-filter pedal combining grainy low gain with round fuzz/distortion and experimental filtered textures.
Expanded dual-filter fuzz with resonant low-pass and high-pass filtering, capable of low-gain fuzz/distortion through extreme noise textures.
Multi-mode distortion and fuzz pedal offering soft saturation, aggressive gated fuzz, presets and expression-controlled sound shaping.
Discrete-silicon distortion ranging from warm overdrive to loud, dark and aggressive distortion with extensive mid and tone shaping.
High-gain dirt pedal with a dense, aggressive character that pushes from distortion into fuzz-like saturation.
Overdrive designed around dynamic amplifier-like breakup with a responsive gain range and strong note definition.
Dual-channel overdrive/distortion with independent gain, level and three-band EQ, ranging from low-gain amp-like drive to tight high-gain tones.
High-gain distortion designed to deliver the touch sensitivity and response of a powerful tube amplifier, from authoritative rock tones through saturated gain.
Low-to-medium gain overdrive with a smooth, dynamic response designed for articulate amplifier-style breakup.
Bass preamp with optical compression, three-band EQ and an overdrive channel covering overdrive through distortion.
Dual-channel analog drive with independent channels and boost, overdrive and distortion modes that can be stacked for higher gain.
Dual-channel analog overdrive based around two classic late-1970s-style drive voices with extensive stacking and voicing options.
Compact high-gain distortion voiced for aggressive modern metal-style attack and tight response.
Compact Muff-style fuzz delivering thick, saturated sustain with a familiar creamy fuzz character.
Compact distortion with an aggressive, tight response and classic hard-clipping character.
Compact high-gain distortion designed for forceful, saturated guitar tones.
Compact Centaur-style overdrive designed for transparent-to-mid-focused drive and amp-pushing applications.
Compact Screamer-style overdrive providing familiar mid-focused drive, boost and singing sustain.
Germanium fuzz and distortion combining vintage-style fuzz response with modern EQ control, from warm early-fuzz textures to aggressive fuzz rock.
Tiny always-on overdrive based on the Barbershop character, offering a wide flat response or a slightly high-cut voicing.
British-voiced overdrive/distortion covering crunchy amplifier breakup through heavier saturated rock gain.
Handmade drive pedal ranging from bluesy overdrive to full distortion, with boost and germanium fuzzier-distortion modes.
Compact overdrive designed for smooth, warm classic drive with simple Gain and Tone controls.
Transistor-based saturation pedal covering boost, overdrive, distortion and fuzz with adjustable bias and filtering.
Dynamic gain pedal ranging from clean boost and articulate overdrive through harmonically rich distortion and full fuzz saturation.
Analog octave fuzz/distortion inspired by the classic bass octave-fuzz concept, with extensive control over harmonics and wet/dry blend.
Analog pedal combining Japanese distortion and Soviet fuzz voices with hybrid combinations of clipping and tone sections.
Dual analog dirt pedal combining distinct Muff-style fuzz and RAT-style distortion circuits, each capable of independent gain and tonal shaping.
JFET high-gain distortion/fuzz designed to move from clean and crunchy sounds into saturated gain with strong sustain and amp-like response.
One-knob amp-like overdrive designed to provide refined, gritty cranked-amplifier breakup at controllable volume.
Aggressive distortion designed for heavy, pulverizing gain and strong tonal shaping.
Minimalist fuzz designed to provide straightforward saturated fuzz tones in a compact one-knob format.
Germanium fuzz based on the classic Fuzzrite sound, emphasizing vintage-style bite, texture and cleanup.
Harmonic fuzz with germanium character, producing compressed, complex and expressive saturation.
High-gain hybrid distortion and fuzz drawing on classic British and RAT-family gain characteristics.
Rich, woolly fuzz with broad sustain and harmonically dense character.
Amp-inspired overdrive/distortion designed around thick low-end response and flexible gain from gritty breakup to saturated drive.
British-style amplifier preamp/overdrive designed for dense, aggressive gain and classic hard-rock saturation.
